hero.title: An intimate Cantonese and Chiu Chow dining journey
hero.description: Seasonal ingredients, chef-led tasting menus, and bespoke hospitality for a memorable evening

menuShowcase.Title: Crafted Ingredients
menuShowcase.Description: Every ingredient carries a story of the earth, the sea, and the seasons—curated thoughtfully to bring nature's poetry to life

menuPage.title: A Selection of Signature Dishes
menuPage.description: Each dish is prepared with seasonal produce, refined Cantonese techniques, and the chef's dedication to balance, aroma, and texture.

6452.name: Crispy Pickled Radish with Sauce
6452.description: Radish pickled in a house sauce until crisp and refreshing, with balanced saltiness—a classic appetiser.

6606.name: Silky Abalone with Multigrain Rice
6606.description: South African abalone glazed in rich abalone sauce over multigrain rice; tender, bouncy, and deeply flavoured.

6663.name: Fish Maw Rice Braised in Abalone Sauce
6663.description: Fish maw slow-braised in abalone sauce until soft and silky, folded into fragrant rice with a concentrated finish.

6843.name: Hua Diao Glass Prawn Balls
6843.description: Hand-pounded prawns shaped into translucent balls, finished with Shaoxing wine for springy texture and elegant aroma.

6914.name: Hand-Picked Shad Fish Paste Soup
6914.description: Fresh shad filleted to order, the paste silky and the broth clear yet rich—pure river-fish sweetness.

6958.name: Hand-Picked Crab Roe with Shark Fin
6958.description: Crab meat and roe picked fresh, braised with shark fin in a slow-cooked broth—luxurious and deeply savoury.

6984.name: Steamed Crab with Hand-Chopped Pork Patty
6984.description: Creamy crab roe paired with a hand-chopped pork patty—a Tai Zi Hui signature with layered umami.

7069.name: Lemon Salted Egg King Prawns
7069.description: King prawns coated in golden salted egg and lemon, crisp outside and springy within, bright and balanced.

7092.name: Nostalgic Gourd Duck
7092.description: Classic gourd-shaped duck, crisp skin and tender meat, slow-cooked in traditional Cantonese style.

7208.name: Classic Baked Ma Gang Goose
7208.description: Ma Gang goose baked with Hai Chang sauce in a time-honoured recipe—crisp skin, juicy meat, rich glaze.

7261.name: Fresh Crab Meat and Wild Herb Tart
7261.description: Hand-picked crab layered with seasonal wild herbs in a refined tart—fresh, light, and elegantly composed.

7287.name: Dried Shrimp Paste Oyster Toast
7287.description: Golden oysters seasoned with dried shrimp paste on crisp toast—sweet, savoury, and distinctly Hong Kong.

7310.name: Crispy Fried Beef Shoulder
7310.description: Beef shoulder fried until crisp outside and tender within, served with a house sauce—rich without heaviness.

7340.name: Alaskan King Crab Cheung Fun with Three Onions
7340.description: Alaskan king crab wok-tossed with three onions and silky cheung fun—wok hei, crab sweetness, and smooth rice rolls.

7435.name: Tai O Shrimp Roe Pomelo Peel
7435.description: Tai O shrimp roe over pomelo peel braised in superior stock—soft, umami-rich, a showcase of Cantonese braising.

7439.name: Pan-Fried Giant Grouper Fin with Green Peppercorn
7439.description: Giant grouper fin pan-fried with green peppercorn sauce—lightly charred, silky texture, fragrant and appetising.

7471.name: Bone-Fragrant Turbot
7471.description: Whole turbot pan-fried bone-in until the skin is crisp and the flesh delicate—bone fragrance woven through each bite.
